Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You pull sound pieces from the wreckage, lay them beside your tools and fit them together into something the party can use.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
The recipe’s stated interval per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One known ordinary recipe and plausible local materials; recipe interval
Duration
Crafted items and supplies persist until used or destroyed.
Equipment / acquisition
Craft tools, Bulk 1, if absent; choose two compatible ordinary recipes. No materials granted.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Crafting / Utility

Grants craft tools if absent and two ordinary recipes. For this card, equivalent salvaged materials may replace the recipe’s ordinary materials when the DA judges them suitable. Still requires a recipe; no magic or free ingredients.

Weak
1 progress or inventory step.
Standard
2 progress or inventory steps.
Strong
3 progress or inventory steps; leave the workspace ready for immediate reuse.

Compatible ordinary choices are Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord, Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg. Other recipe types require their named crafting permission.
